title: Induced path in a connected non-complete graph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph that is connected but not complete. Then there exist vertices $u$, $v$, $w$ of $G$ such that $u$ is adjacent to $v$ and $v$ is adjacent to $w$, yet $u$ is not adjacent to $w$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
replaced:
\emph{If \texttt{G} is simple and connected but not complete, then
\texttt{G} has three vertices \texttt{u}, \texttt{v} and \texttt{w} such that \texttt{uv, vw $\in$ E} and \texttt{uw $\notin$ E}.}
